thermal.jpg.note: Rendered thermal palette; no calibrated temperature values are implied.

terrain.glb.origin: LiDAR ground fit, corrected wide-camera DSM and Esri World Imagery
terrain.glb.method: Continuous terrain with georeferenced aerial colour

east-surface.glb.method: Preserve source triangles; remove invalid fragments; fit vertical correction to LiDAR; orthographic source texture

building.positions.bin.inputSampling: Every 20th LAS record, preserving its original XYZ and RGB
building.positions.bin.selection: One original source point per occupied 0.06 metre voxel; no averaging or surface fitting
building.positions.bin.geometry: Measured points only. No inferred roof, wall, window or courtyard geometry.
building.positions.bin.colour: Original captured RGB; reversible display grading is applied in the browser.
building.positions.bin.limits: The scan contains occlusions and gaps. Unobserved surfaces are not reconstructed.

building-surface.glb.source: building.positions.bin and building.colors.bin, derived from original LAS
building-surface.glb.method: Oriented-normal Poisson reconstruction, depth 10; proximity and triangle support trimming
building-surface.glb.colour: Nearest original captured RGB; reversible natural daylight display grading
building-surface.glb.limits: Surface estimation smooths small detail. Unsupported areas are removed; source occlusions may remain. Use Original points for measured truth.
